stage: finite pre-replay admission screen; review before any portfolio replay
question: Does granular class selection and/or volatility normalization produce an affordable, informative momentum mapping across the full supported first-wave ETF pool?

score.raw: 126-session adjusted close return, ending at the prior session close
score.risk: raw score divided by 63-session sample standard deviation of adjusted daily simple returns, annualized by sqrt(252)
score.eligibility: shared prior-253-observation, raw-dollar-liquidity and duplicate admission mask; positive raw 126-session momentum; finite strictly positive volatility
score.zero_volatility: unavailable for every arm; never impute or add a fitted volatility floor
score.cash_like_funds: BIL remains a candidate, with the same positive momentum and volatility tests; report bill weights and low-volatility dominance explicitly

construction.pooled: top six eligible members by the declared score; inverse-volatility weights; gross budget 0.98 times selected_count/6
construction.class: within each primary class choose up to two eligible members; class score is their mean declared score; select top three classes, with deterministic alphabetical class ties; each class has gross budget 0.98/3 times selected_count/2; divide it by inverse volatility
construction.unfilled_slots: cash, including missing class slots; do not redistribute unused budgets
construction.cap: each security capped at 0.45 after sizing; excess stays cash
construction.primary_class_rule: one class per fund; each class gets at most one class-selection vote
construction.duplicate_rule: inherit frozen parent admission: highest prior-63-session median raw dollar volume per duplicate group, then permanent candidate ID
construction.overlap_rule: broad parent/child fund conflicts listed below cannot be co-selected. Pooled selection greedily skips conflicts by score; class selection greedily skips conflicting members against already chosen classes, recomputes each remaining class's available top two and score, and chooses the next class. Within-class selection also skips conflicts. No look-through independence is claimed.
construction.downstream: transparent construction-only family: no financial ridge, XGBoost, activity or USD overlay; it is not FR25 and does not amend the rejected expanded FR25

taxonomy.basis: explicit modelling groups derived from the frozen first-wave inventory; not certified historical classifications or verified look-through weights
boundary_rules: Semiconductors, energy producers and materials funds are equities.
Silver/platinum have one precious-metal class with industrial exposure disclosed, never a second vote.
Hong Kong remains separate from mainland China; European grouping includes UK, not an EU-membership claim.
Broad regional/commodity parents retain explicit overlap conflicts rather than being labelled independent breadth.
Pure energy-futures and chemicals proxies are absent from this admitted wave; do not substitute equity producers.
Overlap edges are conservative predeclared structural exclusions, not a complete historical holdings-overlap audit.

adoption: existing app research adoption_schedule: monthly anchors always adopt; otherwise strictly greater than threshold on L1 latest theoretical versus last adopted targets including cash; no held-weight input

pretest.ic: monthly Spearman of nonzero/zero final target weights versus next 21-session adjusted open-to-open returns across the full admissible pool, including momentum-ineligible zero weights; measure the composed mapping, not an untraded latent score
pretest.degenerate_cross_section: skip with explicit reason; never substitute programme reference IC
pretest.cost: sum absolute security-target changes, including initial establishment; no cash pseudo-trade; annualize over fixed start through calibration_end; target-change proxy only, not actual turnover
pretest.sigma: pooled matching 21-session forward-return sample standard deviation
pretest.decision: pass requires both unchanged P4.15 thresholds on calibration; later-period diagnostics cannot rescue failure; an admission pass is not strategy acceptance
pretest.stage_boundary: publish all 16 screens and review; do not replay gate-rejected mappings or optimize the grid

later_diagnostics: 2025-01-01 through cutoff, plus each calendar year; same monthly IC clock; labels must finish inside each window; continuous adopted anchors, no later-period artificial liquidation/re-establishment

uncertainty.method: joint stationary bootstrap of monthly mapping IC observations; all 16 mappings resampled with identical indices; missing or constant months remain missing
uncertainty.family: 16 mappings, including controls; report individual and Bonferroni 95% family intervals; descriptive and conditional on this inspected cohort

next_stage_if_survivors.controls: construction-matched pooled_raw at the same timing, each same-arm monthly control, original 14-ETF FR25 SOTA and URTH on matched inputs/accounting; include an average-exposure-matched pooled control because unfilled class slots and singleton classes create cash
next_stage_if_survivors.objective: net Sharpe with +0.05 minimum improvement, CAGR no more than 0.5 percentage points worse and max drawdown no more than 2 percentage points worse versus matched control; positive Sharpe advantage under 10bp and one-session delay
next_stage_if_survivors.requirements: native/Python parity, actual turnover/costs, whole-unit USD accounting, full constituent/class PnL and exposure, episode drawdowns, annual stability and family-adjusted paired inference before any recommendation; review/freeze replay implementation first

limitations: Current surviving first-wave cohort, not historical universe membership. Class and overlap history is not certified; retrospective diagnostic only.
Audited adjusted prices are revised histories, not certified publication vintages; audited raw dollar volume is not tape-certified.
Use the pinned October 12 cutoff for comparability; this is not a claim that current app prices end there.
BWX listing hold and CPER unsupported raw-volume observation remain excluded; all 52 candidates are accounted for.
Simple momentum and risk-normalization parameters are declared design choices informed by prior research, not untouched out-of-sample hypotheses.
The new construction omits FR25 overlays, so its gate is not a matched FR25 performance comparison. Existing SOTA results remain the later replay hurdle.
Target-change costs omit held-weight drift and fills; old mapping calibration is not assumed to certify new dynamic-policy turnover.
No NAV, Sharpe, drawdown, achievable execution advantage, alpha discovery or prospective evidence is claimed by this screen.
No FX, macro, historical spreads or fill inputs are used. Unresolved FX and historical membership block broader promotion claims.
